# 2018 Elections

There were 3 elections held in Jersey in 2018.

- **[Senators General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2018#e41)**

  8 seats · 17 candidates · 43.5% turnout
- **[Deputies General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2018#e42)**

  29 seats (3 uncontested) · 61 candidates · 42.3% average turnout
- **[Connétables General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2018#e43)**

  12 seats (11 uncontested) · 13 candidates · 60.8% turnout

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

[**View a sentiment analysis of the manifestos**](https://flow.je/elections/2018/analysis)
